name: Growing Green Youth Program
what_you_do: Teens work on an urban farm and in food enterprise while learning about food systems and social justice organizing. It is a year-round paid job with leadership training.
who_can_apply: Buffalo youth ages 14 to 19. Other rules not stated.
pay_detail: Paid. The hourly wage is not stated.
deadline_text: No dates posted. The page asks you to email the Youth Education Director.
how_to_apply: Email Neena Hussey, the Youth Education Director, at neena@mass-ave.org. Ask about joining as a teen employee.
notes: No application form or deadline is posted, so email first. Office: 387 Massachusetts Ave, Buffalo, NY 14213. Phone: 716-882-5327.
